reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that adding 10-20 at.% Pt to FeCoNi will induce L1₀ ordering; the L1₀ phase typically requires near-equiatomic compositions (e.g., FePt, CoPt) and such a low Pt content in a high-entropy matrix is far more likely to remain a disordered fcc solid solution, undermining the proposed mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, using XRD for ordering detection and VSM for coercivity, with an explicit falsification criterion based on the absence of L1₀ peaks and coercivity below 100 Oe.
reasons.usefulness: Despite being testable, the hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamentally flawed premise about phase formation, so testing it would not advance understanding of coercivity enhancement in fcc high-entropy alloys.
